issues.title: gachalist, loot, and mobskill were registered at rank 0
issues.summary: Canonical master explicitly registers gachalist, loot, and mobskill at GM rank 2, with source-level regression coverage.
issues.required_close: Deploy the fixed server build to production and verify an ordinary player is denied while GM2+ can invoke the commands.

issues.title: startevent ignored a single participant-limit argument
issues.summary: Canonical master now accepts no argument for the default limit of 50 or exactly one positive integer player limit; invalid inputs are rejected and regression-tested.
issues.required_close: Deploy the fixed server build and verify default and custom-limit behavior in a controlled GM event test.

issues.title: Historical account purge semantics can leave character-related rows
issues.summary: The legacy base schema lacks an account-to-character foreign key. Canonical master now includes a read-only orphan audit and a fail-closed ON DELETE RESTRICT relationship guard, but existing production orphans must be audited and remediated before applying it.
issues.required_close: Run tools/everleaf-ops/audit-account-character-integrity.sql on production, back up and deliberately remediate any historical orphan rows, apply the relationship-guard migration, and verify zero relationship-integrity failures.

issues.title: Launcher-only and single-client policy enforcement
issues.summary: Canonical master requires the managed launcher handoff and now blocks multiple stock clients with launcher process/mutex checks, a machine-wide native client mutex, and exclusive one-time launch-ticket consumption.
issues.required_close: Publish the updated managed launcher/client and verify direct EverLeaf.exe rejection, normal launcher launch, second-launch rejection, and rapid/race second-launch rejection on a clean player machine. If cryptographic server-backed launcher proof is later required, implement a server-validated launch-session protocol.

issues.title: Richer Discord Rich Presence gameplay activity
issues.summary: Canonical master now samples character name, level, job and field ID from Angel.idb-pinned GMS v83 getters on CUserLocal::Update, cross-checks local/context field IDs, and fails closed to basic EverLeaf activity on invalid or transitional state.
issues.required_close: Build and publish the updated managed client, then verify Discord activity across login, character entry, map changes, job/level changes, channel changes, logout and reconnect without crashes or stale activity.

issues.title: Account recovery is staff-queue based rather than automated reset-token flow
issues.summary: The public recovery form creates a deduplicated staff-reviewed request; it does not send an automated password-reset token/email.
issues.required_close: Only close if a deliberate self-service recovery flow is implemented, tested, deployed, and documented; otherwise retain as an accepted limitation.
